title: fix: use md: breakpoint for 2-column grid layouts in DetailSection
body:
`DetailSection` grid classes used `sm:grid-cols-2` but tests expected `md:grid-cols-2`, causing 2 test failures on main.

- Updated `DetailSection.tsx` responsive grid breakpoints from `sm:` → `md:` for 2-column layouts
- Fixed stale comment in test file

```diff
- effectiveColumns === 2 ? "grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2" :
- effectiveColumns === 3 ? "grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" :
+ effectiveColumns === 2 ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2" :
+ effectiveColumns === 3 ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" :
```
